description: Network radio audio, waterfall and FT8 contacts with logging

store.summary: Direct radio audio, waterfall and FT8 contacts with Wavelog/QRZ logging.
store.description: Choose Radio for direct network audio, waterfall and receive tuning, or FT8 for silent decoding and explicitly initiated contacts. FT8 preserves an existing designated dial frequency or requires a band choice before beginning, and shows CQ calls, your conversations and local TX records after their 15-second period ends. F/X selects lines; Enter or the selected-decode menu continues a contact from its current grid/report/acknowledgment stage. Auto audio frequency follows the selected station and replies use the opposite UTC period. Settings also allow a fixed audio frequency and nominal RF power. IC-7300MK2 FT8 uses USB-D/FIL1 with DATA MOD/LAN and readback gating. Network address changes reconnect without restarting TX. Auto CQ queues callers heard during exchanges. It sends one own CQ, then calls up to five strong recent CQ stations twice each before stopping if unanswered. Queued callers have priority after a contact; advancing exchanges retain four attempts per stage. POTA Hunt monitors tagged POTA/SOTA CQs and starts with a direct R-report, retries three unanswered transmissions per stage, then rests and resumes monitoring. QSOs require actual exchanged reports. Centered pop-ups show notices and RF warnings; Enter requests safe warning clearance. POTA/SOTA CQ rows are green. Bundled offline data estimates countries/territories and shows USA-XX registered states from a minimized FCC callsign/state snapshot. States describe registered license addresses, not live portable locations. Local CTY.DAT replacement is supported. Auto CQ writes private session journals on the device. Saved QSOs have an optional speaker beep and Auto CQ ending without responses has a distinct beep. Tab includes Bands, Call CQ, Auto CQ, POTA Hunt, Settings, Record QSO, Logging, antenna tuning and Help. Record QSO reviews exchanged reports for an explicitly confirmed manual log. Completed contacts use RRR, save locally and upload independently to Wavelog/QRZ; a green popup confirms local saving. QRZ may require an API subscription. FT8 automatically starts antenna tuning on entry and band changes, briefly transmitting a carrier. SWR above 2.0, excessive ALC or missing active-TX telemetry stop TX with a latched warning. Requires configured callsign/grid, synchronized device time and radio TX permission. Direct Icom profiles cover IC-705, IC-7300MK2, IC-7610, IC-7760, IC-7850/7851, IC-905, IC-9700 and IC-R8600 (RX only). TS-890S uses native KNS. IC-7300MK2 is hardware-tested; other models await physical validation. Credentials stay private on the device.
